source_title: Buyers Edge Platform Names Sam Peterson Chief Technology Officer to Accelerate AI-Driven Innovation
source_excerpt:
WALTHAM, Mass. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Buyers Edge Platform (BEP), a leading digital procurement network and solutions provider for the foodservice industry, today announced the appointment of Sam Peterson as Chief Technology Officer (CTO). The appointment reinforces BEP's commitment to building industry-leading technology and harnessing AI to deliver greater value for the operators, distributors, and manufacturers it serves.
As BEP continues to scale its platform and expand its portfolio of solutions, technology remains central to how the company serves customers. In his new role, Peterson will lead BEP's technology and engineering organization, AI-enabled product innovation, and faster, more efficient delivery of solutions to market.
Peterson has built a career adopting leading-edge technology, building high-performing engineering organizations, and delivering results materially faster at lower cost, with experience spanning public companies, private equity-backed businesses, and international teams.
Most recently, he served as Chief Technology Officer at Renaissance Inc., a philanthropic-services fintech , where he rebuilt engineering around AI-first delivery, and established an AI Governance Council to ensure responsible adoption at scale. Previously, he held executive technology and product leadership roles at Truckstop, Metrc, and Boats Group, where he led the platform consolidation and international acquisition integration that supported the company's successful exit. Earlier in his career, he spent 14 years at Overstock.com, rising from its first software developer to Senior Vice President and CTO of a 650-person technology, product, and program organization.
"We are thrilled to welcome Sam Peterson as Buyers Edge Platform's Chief Technology Officer," said John Davie, CEO of BEP. "Technology is at the core of everything we do for our customers, and Sam brings a rare combination of deep engineering expertise, proven AI transformation experience, and a track record of building teams that deliver. His leadership will be instrumental as we continue to innovate across our platform and help the foodservice industry operate smarter."
Peterson joined BEP as CTO effective October 12, 2026. In his role, he will collaborate across all divisions and enterprise functions to shape BEP's technology strategy and roadmap, further solidifying the company's position as an industry innovator.
"Technology and AI are reshaping every part of the foodservice industry," Sam stated. "Having built data products at Boats Group and Truckstop, I know what it takes to turn marketplace data into customer value, and Buyers Edge Platform's visibility into more than $100 billion in annual purchasing across 350,000 foodservice locations is the richest foundation I've had to work with. I look forward to building on it to drive innovation for our customers."
